description: Finance Decision Council reliability and analytical quality benchmark

execution_reliability.description: Council execution completes without unhandled exceptions

structured_output_validity.description: Agent outputs satisfy their Pydantic schemas

evidence_grounding.description: Claims are supported by supplied market evidence

unsupported_claims.description: Agents avoid inventing metrics, benchmarks, or facts

analytical_defensibility.description: Assessment follows logically from available evidence

outlook_consistency.description: Final outlook respects agent assessments and evidence limitations

constraints: Evaluation must not depend on live market data
Confidence scores are not accuracy measurements
Reference expectations must not require predicting future returns
Missing evidence must not be treated as negative evidence
